name: speedle-manage
description: Human-supervised Speedle policy management through PMS. Never grant manage mode to an agent that is itself governed by the policies in that Speedle service.

SPEEDLE_PMS_ENDPOINT.title: PMS endpoint
SPEEDLE_PMS_ENDPOINT.description: Speedle PMS or Cloud base URL. Use the local default or enter your deployment's URL.

SPEEDLE_PMS_BACKEND.title: PMS backend
SPEEDLE_PMS_BACKEND.description: Select speedle for self-hosted PMS or speedle-cloud for Speedle Cloud. A token alone does not select Cloud.

SPEEDLE_PMS_TOKEN.title: PMS bearer token
SPEEDLE_PMS_TOKEN.description: Bearer token required for Speedle Cloud. Use only the PMS scope needed; HTTPS is required.
